'''Troy Caswell''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[December 2000 Las Vegas tournament (16 December)]] on 16 December 2000, according to Steve Marshall's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1558">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-12-18-viper-visits-vegas-sealed-12-16-00d1558/ viper-visits-vegas-sealed-12-16-00], DeckTech (Steve "BlackViper" Marshall, 18 December 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-12-18-viper-visits-vegas-sealed-12-16-00d1558/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
